title: Scam
body: After a few weeks of getting a week long membership, I decided it would be worth it to purchase the year long membership. Every day you can earn coins by watching for time, episodes, and dramas. I have been getting deducted coins when I am supposed to be earning coins. I brought it up to the app’s feedback and their response was I don’t get a bonus. There is no bonus, just the coins that are earned. Even if those coins were not accumulating, it shouldn’t be deducting after I watch. This basically means that while I can watch dramas during the membership period, I can’t earn any coins for future dramas after the membership ends. When I had the weekly subscription I was able to use all of these benefits to watch one or two extra dramas after the membership. This is a total scam and I wish I had not wasted my money so foolishly. I definitely do not recommend this app at all.
